sources.title: Olof B. Widlund, Introduction to the Design and Theory of Domain Decomposition Algorithms: DD20 Tutorial
sources.locator: Complete 98-page tutorial PDF retrieved; inspected pp. 24–34 for trace spaces, H^{1/2}_{00} edge cutoffs and the discrete Sobolev estimate, pp. 35–37 for Schur elimination, and pp. 83–97 for FETI-DP, BDDC, scaling projections, spectra and the 2D coefficient-scaled condition-number argument.
sources.source_kind_detail: Author-hosted 98-page graduate tutorial by Olof B. Widlund, Courant Institute, New York University.
sources.not_read: The complete PDF was retrieved, but the authoring record claims inspection only of the locators above; unrelated tutorial pages are not used.

contents.name: Reference model, energy, local subdomains, and interface Schur elimination, pp. 35–37
contents.support: Used to cross-check the stated scalar energy and block-elimination conventions; the authored definitions and exact arguments are local.

contents.name: Trace spaces, zero extension, H^{1/2}_{00} edge norm, logarithmic edge cutoff and discrete Sobolev inequality, pp. 24–34
contents.support: The cited pages motivate the exact edge-weight integral and cone proof; the local item supplies the complete estimates used by the condition theorem.

contents.name: FETI-DP/BDDC definitions, partial assembly, primal/dual projections and coefficient scaling, pp. 83–90, 96–97
contents.support: The definitions and scaling convention are adopted with the explicit multiplier range convention stated locally.

contents.name: FETI-DP and BDDC nontrivial spectral comparison, pp. 90–93
contents.support: The source motivates the comparison; the item proves the complementary-operator argument directly, including the eigenvalue-one exception.

contents.name: Projection eigenvalue bounds and 2D coefficient-scaled condition-number route, pp. 94–97
contents.support: The source fixes the coefficient scaling and reduction to an energy norm bound; the item locally proves the complete edgewise estimate and spectral consequence.

contents.name: Abstract left-inverse eigenvalue bound, pp. 94–95
contents.support: The tutorial gives the bound by Cauchy–Schwarz in the interface energy; the local lemma derives both endpoint inequalities in full.

contents.name: Condition-number versus acceptable preconditioner cost, pp. 3 and 87–89
contents.support: The source distinguishes spectral convergence from the cost of the local and coarse solves; the dense complexity count is stated separately in the generated B-page example.

contents.name: Discussion of parallel methods and algorithm design beyond the selected scalar 2D theorem
contents.reason: The PE26 claims do not extend to elasticity, 3D vertex-only constraints, arbitrary graph partitions, adaptive coarse spaces or inexact-solver guarantees.

read_evidence.access_method: Opened the full author-hosted PDF in the web reader and inspected the title/extent and the exact printed tutorial pages listed in locator.
read_evidence.extent: The whole 98-page PDF was retrieved; only pages 24–37 and 83–97 are claimed as read and used. No full-document mathematical review is claimed.

sources.title: Oliver Rheinbach, Parallel Scalable Iterative Substructuring: Robust Exact and Inexact FETI-DP Methods with Applications to Elasticity
sources.locator: Complete 186-page dissertation PDF retrieved; Chapter 1, §§1.6–1.7, printed pp. 21–22 (PDF pages 20–21), for discrete harmonic minimization and the Schur/H1/2 norm equivalence; Chapter 2, §§2.1–2.4, printed pp. 24–47 (PDF pages 23–46), for subdomain Schur matrices, primal constraints, edge and vertex estimates, Theorems 2.4.1–2.4.3 and the detailed scalar 2D logarithmic proof.
sources.source_kind_detail: 2006 Dr. rer. nat. dissertation, Department of Mathematics, University of Duisburg–Essen; reviewed by Axel Klawonn, Olof B. Widlund and Gerhard Starke.
sources.not_read: Only Chapter 1 §§1.6–1.7 and Chapter 2 §§2.1–2.4, including the associated local condition-number proof, are claimed as inspected; later chapters on elasticity, spectral elements and computations are outside this pair.

contents.name: §§1.6–1.7: discrete harmonic minimization and Schur/H1/2 boundary norm equivalence, pp. 21–22
contents.support: The stated equivalence and minimum-energy convention were checked; the local proof gives its own trace/lifting derivation rather than using the citation as a proof substitute.

contents.name: Theorem 2.4.1: scaled jump projection stability; local Schur energy representation, pp. 39–41
contents.support: Used for the local energy organization and the meaning of the projection estimate; the authored proof expands and justifies every edge estimate.

contents.name: Discrete Sobolev, edge cutoff, edge-average subtraction and primal-vertex control, pp. 40–44
contents.support: The exact logarithmic sources and the edge/vertex split were inspected; the local supplier proves its cone and weighted-integral estimates explicitly.

contents.name: Subdomain-constant coefficient scaling and the two-dimensional condition-number estimate, Theorems 2.4.1–2.4.2, pp. 39–45
contents.support: The source proves the squared logarithmic rate and coefficient-independent bound under the selected vertex constraints; the authored theorem states the precise bounded polygon/mesh family.

contents.name: Theorem 2.4.3: BDDC/FETI-DP spectra except zero and one, pp. 45–47
contents.support: The excerpt's proof refers to linear algebra; the local proof supplies that linear algebra and removes zero modes by the declared multiplier range convention.

contents.name: Elasticity, three-dimensional wire-basket/face constraints and later inexact solver algorithms
contents.reason: PE26 does not make any of these broader claims.

read_evidence.access_method: Opened the full dissertation PDF and inspected its title page, table of contents, complete Chapter 2 proof passages at PDF pages 38–46, including the local scaling, edge, vertex and eigenvalue arguments.
read_evidence.extent: The 186-page document was retrieved. The reading claim covers Chapter 1 §§1.6–1.7 and Chapter 2 §§2.1–2.4; no claim is made that all 186 pages were read.

sources.title: Jan Mandel and Bedřich Sousedík, BDDC and FETI-DP under Minimalist Assumptions
sources.locator: Complete 11-page arXiv v1 PDF retrieved; §§3.1–3.3, pp. 3–5, for the abstract spaces/operators and preconditioners; §4, pp. 5–8, for eigenvalue and condition-number lemmas; §5, pp. 9–11, for the substructuring specialization.
sources.source_kind_detail: Full-text author-uploaded arXiv paper, version 1, submitted 29 August 2007; authors Jan Mandel and Bedřich Sousedík.
sources.not_read: The full 11-page paper was retrieved; inspection is claimed for §§3–5, not for every reference cited by the paper.

contents.name: Abstract hypotheses (2)–(7), partial-assembly projection, jump kernel and range multiplier convention, §3.1
contents.support: Used to confirm that redundant jump rows are handled by taking the multiplier space to be range(B), and that the generalized inverse identities suffice.

contents.name: BDDC variational definition and operator form, §3.2
contents.support: Used to cross-check the exact constrained energy formulation; the local proposition proves the finite-dimensional minimizer statement.

contents.name: FETI-DP saddle point, dual Schur system and preconditioner, §3.3
contents.support: The local proof derives the same equations by direct elimination and establishes positivity on range(B).

contents.name: Abstract eigenvalue lemma 4.1 and spectral comparison lemma 4.2, §4
contents.support: Used as an independent comparison for the operator identities; the local proof derives the eigenvalue mapping and multiplicity argument.

contents.name: Lemma 4.1 left-inverse eigenvalue interval, §4
contents.support: The result is reconstructed with the explicit finite-dimensional Cauchy–Schwarz proof in the local item.

contents.name: Two-coordinate BDDC/FETI-DP matrix specialization, §4
contents.support: The local example computes the matrices and the common eigenvalue directly.

contents.name: Abstract norm condition-number estimate, §4
contents.support: Used for the energy-norm reduction; the local proof supplies the FE-specific logarithmic bound.

read_evidence.access_method: Opened the direct arXiv PDF, which exposed all 11 pages; inspected the hypotheses and definitions in §§3.1–3.3 and the proof of Lemma 4.1 and comparison results in §4.
read_evidence.extent: All 11 pages were retrieved. The authoring record claims only the sections and page ranges in the locator; cited earlier papers were not treated as read or as proof substitutes.
